notes: The owner: "the tab that is labeled 'Surface' will be confusing. It might be better to call it 'Community'" — right for a reason the 5.85.1 rename did not weigh: the application is CALLED Open Trading Surface, so a tab named Surface reads as the product's own name. Community names what the tab holds: other people, their channels, their shared research. Label-only, the third time the rule has applied: the vertical id stays chat, -17 stays -17, every door, verb and store path is unchanged, and panel titles follow the label with no migration.
